individual-data-points.explanation: Stacked bar/area chart of median state frequencies per bin; this type of aggregate categorical plot across many promoters is not amenable to overlaying individual points, and bins already summarize many promoters.
Each row of the single-molecule stack represents an individual DNA molecule, so individual data points (molecules) are directly displayed, not just an average.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The middle line of the box represents the median. The box displays the interquartile range (IQR), 25th to 75th percentile. Whiskers represent a distance of 1.5 x IQR.
